chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Prayer of the Two Eids, he said: 'He takbir (says God is Great), then recites, then takbirs five times and makes qunut (supplication) between every two takbirs, then takbirs the seventh, then bows with it, then prostrates, then stands in the second [rak'ah], recites, then takbirs four times, makes qunut between every two takbirs, then takbirs and bows with it.'

key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْعِيدَيْنِ: The Prayer of the Two Eids (Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha)

ai.seo_question: What is the step-by-step method for performing the Eid prayer according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* provides a precise juristic blueprint for the Eid prayer, emphasizing the distinct structure of extra takbirs and the placement of qunut between them, which reflects the Shia emphasis on following the Imams' specific ritual practices. The detailed sequence highlights the spiritual significance of the Eid prayer as a communal act of worship and gratitude, reinforcing the continuity of prophetic tradition through the Ahl al-Bayt. This ritual precision serves to unify the community in a standardized form of devotion that distinguishes Shia practice while maintaining core Islamic elements.
